title: Coveo Relevance Cloud pricing - Tiered entry plus custom enterprise
clean_text: Coveo Relevance Cloud has a published entry-level Base plan starting at $600 per month and a Pro plan at $1,320 per month, with a custom enterprise plan available above that for larger deployments. No free plan is offered, though a free trial is available. Full enterprise relevance deployments spanning commerce, service, and workplace search typically scale well beyond the published entry tiers through custom contracts.
